audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Leah’s painting invitation, Elliott’s book-tour departure event with every quick-question response branch, and both variants of Emily’s sewing-machine tutorial. Every spoken line, response option, meeting detail, book-title placeholder, affectionate line, tailoring instruction, reward message, and item reference was reviewed in full event context with canonical Cindersap Forest, Cloth and Emily terminology and consistent Sewing Machine wording. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, world and conversation state, quick-question branch count, placeholders, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The remaining Farm records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
